name: Terra Milk Chocolate Blueberries Bites [20pk] (100mg THC)
description:
5mg THC Per Piece | 100mg THC Total in 20 Pieces
Known simply as “The Blueberries,” these award-winning bites spawned a thousand imitators. Delicious dried blueberries are dusted with cocoa powder and then finished with a generous coating of creamy milk chocolate. Each of these handcrafted treats takes 10+ hours to create.
